original_question: Which chromosome carries the gene responsible for Mohr–Tranebjærg syndrome?

final_qi.question: Which chromosome carries the gene responsible for Mohr–Tranebjærg syndrome?
final_qi.long_answer: Mohr–Tranebjærg syndrome is an X-linked recessive neurodegenerative disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the TIMM8A gene, which is located at band Xp22 on the X chromosome. Because TIMM8A resides on the X chromosome, the disease follows an X-linked inheritance pattern.
